overall.summary: Architecturally the deeper of the two, with three chart views, a history recorder and the only test in either run, but this run was manually interrupted at 1h45 before the visual pass finished, so the delivered garden is unfinished.

standards.summary: 4,330 lines across 25 files with an explicit engine/world/history/analysis separation, a seeded RNG and a test file, which is more structure than any other simulation run here.

findings.title: world.ts carries the bulk of the rules
findings.detail: Even with engine.ts and analysis.ts split out, the 863-line world module carries the bulk of the rules. The per-species decision logic would read better as two modules sharing a common energy accounting layer.

strengths: engine.ts, world.ts, history.ts, analysis.ts and rng.ts each own one concern
sim.test.ts is the only automated test across both simulation runs
Three separate chart components: timeline, phase plot and trait trends
camera.ts and scene.ts keep rendering out of the simulation entirely

specification.summary: Covers more of the brief than its sibling on paper: the phase plot and trait trends the brief lists as helpful extras are both implemented, alongside the required timeline.
strengths: Phase plot and trait-trend charts both implemented, unlike the sibling run
All five presets with descriptions of the expected dynamic
Play, pause, step, reset, randomize plus discrete 0.5x to 8x speed steps
Header KPI strip for time, fruit, blue and red

ux.summary: The delivered surface is visibly mid-iteration. The dish renders in flat tan rather than as a garden, the blobs are small and carry raw energy numbers on their bodies, and the charts sit below the fold on a 1440x900 viewport.

findings.title: Run was interrupted before the visual pass completed
findings.detail: This run was manually stopped at 1h45 and its run status is recorded as failed. The captured state shows the intended structure but not the intended finish: the garden dish is a flat tan ellipse instead of the lush green world the brief asks for, and the three chart views never appear above the fold. The comparison against the high-effort sibling is therefore not like-for-like on visual quality.

findings.title: Raw energy values rendered on the blobs
findings.detail: Each blob carries a small numeric energy readout on its body. At the default zoom these are illegible and turn the characters into data points, working against the 'cute animated ecology toy' the brief asks for. Move energy into the inspector or express it as fill level.

findings.title: Charts are below the fold
findings.detail: The three chart views are the payoff of the simulation and none is visible without scrolling at 1440x900. Bring the timeline into the first screen.

strengths: Discrete speed steps from 0.5x to 8x are easier to reason about than a continuous slider
Preset descriptions state the expected dynamic rather than just naming it
Control labels explain the mechanism, for example 'the tap that feeds the whole garden'
Header KPIs keep the population state visible while scrolling the controls
